verdict.rationale: Workable documents a branded, mobile-friendly careers page built without coding, with custom layout, colors, fonts and media. It also offers an automatically updating branded job widget you can embed on your existing website, so jobs flow from the ATS to your site. However, nothing documents hosting the careers page itself on your own custom domain, and there is no hands-on evidence of the publish flow. Missing for 10: explicit custom-domain support for the hosted careers page, independent or hands-on corroboration that jobs publish automatically to the page.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Create a branded, mobile-friendly careers page with built-in search, filtering, and auto-fill applications without coding skills. Brand with custom layout, brand colors, fonts and media.
Embed an automatically updating, branded job list on your existing website using a simple, customizable widget.
